 Councilmembers Absent: Supernaw

 STUDY SESSION

  Ricks-Oddie, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the
  following vote:

  Yes:  8 Zendejas, Allen, Duggan, Kerr, Saro, Uranga, Thrash-Ntuk, Ricks-
  Oddie
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None
  Absent: 1 Supernaw

  Thomas Modica, City Manager, spoke.
